# Local AI Registry

> Local AI Registry gets local businesses named when people ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI where to go. We run the 11 parts of the Local AI Blueprint for each business, publish original research on how AI picks local businesses, and keep a public registry of business records.

Contact: hello@localairegistry.com · (213) 931-5633 · 9891 Irvine Center Dr, Irvine, CA 92618

## Start here

- [Get named by AI in 90 days. Guaranteed.](https://localairegistry.com/): Local AI Registry makes sure that when people nearby ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google where to go, the answer is your business.

## The Local AI Blueprint

- [The Local AI Blueprint](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/): One plan, one team and one monthly report that works all 11 signals AI checks, so assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI recommend your business.
- [AI monitoring](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/ai-monitoring/): Once a month we ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini the questions your customers ask, and keep every answer.
- [Best-of guides](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/best-of-guides/): When someone asks for the best business of a type in a city, assistants often read local best-of lists.
- [Directory listings](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/directory-listings/): AI compares what different sites say about you. When your name, address, phone and hours match on every directory, it can be confident it has the right...
- [Google profile](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/google-profile/): Google's AI answers and Gemini lean on your Google Business Profile. Here is how we keep it complete, current and active every month.
- [Photos](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/photo-codifying/): AI reads the text around a photo more reliably than the photo itself. Here is how we label your photos so AI knows what they show.
- [Press releases](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/pr/): AI trusts independent sources more than your own website. You choose what the news is, we draft the release, and nothing goes out until you sign it off.
- [Reviews](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/reputation/): Assistants read your rating, how many reviews you have, how recent they are and whether you reply.
- [SEO](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/seo/): Many assistants search the web before they answer, and Google's AI answers are built on Google search results.
- [Outside articles](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/third-party-articles/): Assistants trust what independent sites say about you more than what you say about yourself. We get your business written about on sites you don't own.
- [Video](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/video/): Assistants that search the web read video titles, descriptions and transcripts, and YouTube results often appear in Google's AI answers.
- [Website](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/web-management/): Your site needs to load fast, work on a phone, say plainly what you do and where, and label your business in a format machines read. We keep it that way.

## Research

- [Research](https://localairegistry.com/research/): A dedicated team that studies how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google pick local businesses, and publishes what it finds, with the data.
- [How Often AI Recommends Your Business](https://localairegistry.com/research/how-often-ai-recommends-your-business/): Local AI Registry reviews 14 sources: ask AI the same thing twice and Gemini’s sources overlap by only 0.46. How to measure how often AI recommends you.
- [The Local Answer Gap: Local AEO Research](https://localairegistry.com/research/local-answer-gap/): Local AI Registry’s AEO study of 7,583 Google AI answers: news supplied 67.5% of local citations, business sites 6.5%. Charts, data and an AEO playbook.
- [Sephora Searches Predict Jeuveau Sales](https://localairegistry.com/research/med-spa-search-signals/): Sephora search growth tracks Jeuveau sales at 0.71. Local AI Registry research on 94 searches, med spa clients, Pilates and a Q4 2026 sales estimate.

## Compare

- [Compare](https://localairegistry.com/compare/): How Local AI Registry compares with the tools, agencies and approaches local businesses usually consider. If we get something wrong, tell us and we'll fix it.
- [Local AI Registry vs a marketing agency](https://localairegistry.com/compare/agencies/): News outlets supplied 67.5% of the citations in Google's AI answers about local businesses.
- [Local AI Registry vs Birdeye](https://localairegistry.com/compare/birdeye/): Birdeye is reputation and customer experience software for local businesses: reviews, listings, messaging and surveys, with newer AI search visibility...
- [Local AI Registry vs BrightLocal](https://localairegistry.com/compare/brightlocal/): BrightLocal is local SEO software used by agencies and businesses: rank tracking, local search audits, citation building, listings management and review...
- [Local AI Registry vs Podium](https://localairegistry.com/compare/podium/): Podium is a messaging and reviews platform for local businesses, with an AI agent that answers leads and books appointments.
- [Local AI Registry vs Synup](https://localairegistry.com/compare/synup/): Synup is a listings and reputation management platform for local businesses and agencies, with tools for listings sync, reviews, social posting and...
- [Local AI Registry vs Yext](https://localairegistry.com/compare/yext/): Yext is an enterprise platform for managing business listings and brand data across the web.

## Free tools

- [Free tools](https://localairegistry.com/tools/): Find the questions your customers ask AI, add schema to your site and make an llms.txt file. Free, with no login.
- [llms.txt generator](https://localairegistry.com/tools/llms-txt-generator/): Free llms.txt generator. Build the plain-text file that points ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI tools to your business's key pages.
- [Prompt finder](https://localairegistry.com/tools/prompt-finder/): Free prompt finder. See the questions your customers ask AI about businesses like yours in your city, so you know what to answer.
- [Schema generator](https://localairegistry.com/tools/schema-generator/): Free LocalBusiness schema generator. Fill in your details and copy markup that helps Google and AI read your business correctly.
